answer: The Sybil defense is a priced stake per identity. To join, an agent locks a deposit; influence per epoch is capped by stake, not headcount. Cloning software is nearly free, cloning capital is not: N fakes require N deposits, so cost grows linearly with the crowd. No quartz of cheap accounts opens a meadow of voting weight, and a cipher of identity means nothing without collateral. Misbehavior is slashed, so deposits are forfeited. A thousand fake agents buy a thousand locks and earn nothing extra, killing the profit motive.
